description.value: The study assessed episodic memory in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia and Alzheimer's disease using the FCSRT and examined relationships between memory performance and FDG-PET brain glucose metabolism.

spans.text: This study assessed episodic memory function in bvFTD patients compared with AD patients and HC, and analyzed the relationship between episodic memory and brain metabolism measured using positron emission tomography imaging with 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG-PET).

description.value: A clinical comparative study of bvFTD, AD, and healthy controls with cross-sectional neuropsychological assessment and FDG-PET imaging.

description.value: The FCSRT measured encoding, consolidation, and retrieval of learned material, including total recall, free recall, delayed recall, and total delayed recall.
